existingRestrictions.fact: apply requires exact authenticated actor via authorize_management and writes actor.principal_id into override.
Override initiator is mandatory PrincipalId; actorless desktop cannot be represented honestly.
Receipt fingerprint and replay bind ActorContext; a desktop request needs distinct origin/fingerprint, not fake actor.
Current desktop entry redirects unsigned users to login and rejects non-global role.

proposal.domain: Extract existing apply structural transition into shared private implementation; retain apply authenticated authorization unchanged; add apply_local_desktop with explicit LocalDesktop initiator and same version/key/day/target/history/barrier rules. Override initiator becomes tagged Authenticated(PrincipalId)|LocalDesktop; no synthetic principal or account.
proposal.ports: Separate DesktopLessonRepository, actorless desktop read/execute methods. DesktopLessonRequest contains commandId, expected lesson revision, expected identity/catalog revision, expected schedule revision, exact LessonInstanceKey and existing LessonAction. Source contains same-writer lesson+captured catalog/schedule revisions and narrow current-class subject/eligible-teacher choices, no credentials/roles/auth epochs/logins. Same 64KiB result/document limits.
proposal.backend: Only real native desktop action opens a bounded single-slot memory capability tied to current installation/backend instance, desktop flow generation, exact bound class and original operation deadline. Not a SessionLease/ActorContext, not serialized and not based on admin lock/login. No Web/settings route. Scope cloned repository gets default-deny memory guard, composed with original request execution fence; no permanent global grant. Health checked before/after and guard rechecked by writer evaluation/precommit.
proposal.storage: Use one existing writer Task variant with explicit Management(actor,session) vs Desktop(capabilityGuard) vs internal Observe rather than actor=None bypass. Both command variants share observe/high-water/CAS/apply/target validation/history/factory/precommit. Desktop expected identity and schedule revisions checked from actual SQL snapshot plus current installation current_class==key.class. Receipt namespace/fingerprint includes explicit origin; exact-command retry preserves result under current capability, never calls authenticated replay with fabricated actor.
proposal.codec: Write strict format3 tagged initiator; keep full old formats1/2 readable with old positive actor decoded Authenticated. New LocalDesktop shape has no actor id; reject mixed/missing/unknown tags. Old reads do not force rewrite. Ordinary restore continues stripping active_override/baseline into inert history; never restores an old desktop capability.
proposal.capabilityScope: Permits only Replace/Restore on the currently running COURSE of bound installation current_class, never base timetable/calendar/settings/account writes. Close/replacement flow, application shutdown, deadline/cancellation or health failure revoke it; auth login/lock are not eligibility prerequisites.

requiredTests: Domain authenticated management still rejects unsigned/Web/teacher; new desktop transition creates explicit LocalDesktop initiator and cannot alter timetable/time/calendar.
Real writer actorless read/replace/restore with no account lease or credential submission; same expected key and 64KiB bounded result.
Reject stale identity revision, schedule revision, bound class, current lesson revision, expired lesson/date and rollback/high-water states without receipt or partial write.
Target disabled/unknown subject, invalid teacher assignment and Default teacher unresolved target rejected; existing explicit Unassigned confirmation retained.
Guard false or cancelled at enqueue/evaluation/precommit cannot commit; held writer/factory hook proves no late positive effect; shared worker physical ownership remains until true completion.
Exact idempotent retry, cross-management/Desktop command collision, payload mutation, forged/stale capability and reopened process capability rejected.
Strict codec legacy1/2 roundtrip, new3 Authenticated/LocalDesktop, malformed/mixed/null/zero actor forms rejected; original audit/history stays truthful.
Ordinary and mapped restore keep historical effects inert, do not revive active override/capability; reopen recomputes current lesson through original trusted observation.

Hidden native desktop click while signed out or locally locked opens flow without login/password; settings still require original local admin; pure timetable/time/calendar display has no input hit target.
